theorem_rename_to_conditional_sufficienc.note: Theorem 1 statement and proof sketch now explicitly label C1-C3 as deterministic and the parametric-memory channel as empirical, with an alternate constructive-redaction variant noted. Directly resolves Round-1 Major Comment 2 (deterministic-vs-empirical category error). The honesty of the rename is itself a strength.

abstract_stem_clustered_bound_foreground.note: Abstract Results now states the 3.2 percent stem-clustered Clopper-Pearson upper bound inline. Resolves Round-1 Major Comment 4. Improves the calibration of the headline claim and incidentally tightens the novelty framing because the bound is now part of the contribution rather than buried in Methods.

contribution2_qualified_leak_channel_onl.note: Already counted under the theorem-rename movement. The Contribution 2 text now explicitly states that backbone-invariance applies to the safety/leak axis only and not to utility, with Mistral-7B parse-ok 0.12 and commit 0.11 cited as the case in point. Resolves Round-1 Major Comment 3.

calibration_reframed_as_deployment_safet.note: Section 2.7 and Limitations now frame the negative Brier Skill Score as a deployment-safety contribution (do not use tau as a triage probability) rather than as a defensive limitation. Resolves Round-1 Minor 'calibration framing'. Strengthens the clinical-policy axis because the claim is now actionable for downstream operators.

novelty_paragraph_added_to_intro.note: Already counted under abstract-bound movement. The Introduction paragraph now states explicitly that no published trial-matching system (DeepEnroll, COMPOSE, TrialGPT, PRISM, Trial2Vec) reports a cross-trial leak rate and frames cross-trial conflation as a standard safety dimension. Resolves Round-1 Major Comment 1.

figure2_demoted_to_supplement.note: All-zero leak grid moved to Supplementary Section 5. The main text now leads with the per-area heatmap (real variance) instead of a uniform-zero matrix. Addresses Round-1 optional suggestion and is a strict clarity win because the demoted figure conveyed no information.

float_placement_htbp_and_placeins.note: Already counted under fig2-demotion movement. Switching [t] to [!htbp] plus FloatBarrier at section breaks prevents figure-drift across page breaks. In a 20-plus-page manuscript this is a real readability gain even though it does not change content.

Reduces typographic noise across the manuscript. True code literals (NCT, blind_id) correctly retained in texttt. Already counted under fig2-demotion movement.

supplement_self_bibliography_stripped.note: Supplement-only references collapsed into the main bibliography. No content regression; main-paper citations to Cohen 1960, Landis and Koch 1977, Gwet 2014 remain intact.

regressions_checked.figure2_demotion: no regression - the demoted figure had no within-cell variance and the per-area heatmap now leading is more informative
regressions_checked.supplement_bib_strip: no regression - all kappa-paradox citations remain in the main bibliography
regressions_checked.qualitative_irr_language: minor precision loss in main text but the supplementary anchor (Table S8) is correctly cited; no scoring impact

remaining_weaknesses: n=114 case pool remains at the floor of defensibility for an npj Digital Medicine safety claim; the stem-clustered 3.2 percent upper bound is now foregrounded in the abstract but is still an irreducible constraint of the available evidence base.
The DeepEnroll/COMPOSE/TrialGPT/PRISM/Trial2Vec novelty contrast appears in both Introduction and Discussion; one of the two occurrences could be compressed.

Equity stratification is still by therapeutic area only; language coverage (English-only) and health-literacy proxies are acknowledged in Limitations but not stratified in the analysis - this is deferred to follow-up work and is appropriate at the early-stage DECIDE-AI tier.
The four-role deployment workflow figure (Fig 5) could be supplemented by a textual role x action x audit-artifact table for accessibility; this remains an optional improvement.
Threat model (adversarial-prompt robustness) is acknowledged as out-of-scope but a one-line statement about gate-ensemble input-independence would close the loop; non-blocking.
rationale: Round 2 successfully addressed all five Required Revisions from Round 1: novelty positioning (Major Comment 1), theorem honesty (Major Comment 2), backbone-invariance qualification (Major Comment 3), stem-clustered bound foregrounding (Major Comment 4), and IRR kappa-paradox treatment (Major Comment 5). Style/layout fixes from Round 2 (float placement, font discipline, figure demotion, citation tidy) compound to a clarity improvement. Four of five dimensions are now at 8 or 9; data quality remains at 6 because n=114 is an irreducible constraint of the evidence base, not a methodological deficiency. The paper is at ACCEPT threshold for npj Digital Medicine at the early-stage DECIDE-AI/CLAIM/TRIPOD+AI tier it explicitly claims.
recommendation_to_editor: Accept with the optional improvements noted above flagged as discretionary author-elective polish, not as required revisions. The remaining weaknesses are properly acknowledged as limitations in the manuscript and are appropriate for an early-stage clinical-AI study at this venue.
